articles.title: Bitcoin Drops to Lowest Price Since Trump’s Election Victory
articles.mainIdea: Bitcoin Drops to Lowest Price Since Trump’s Election Victory
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Bitcoin Drops to Lowest Price Since Trump’s Election Victory. “A lot of the traders were trying to buy the dip, betting on a rebound above $80,000,” said Bohan Jiang, senior derivatives trader at FalconX. Bitcoin fell as much as 7% to $72,877 on Tuesday, its lowest since Nov. 6, 2024, before regaining some ground to $76,000 at 3:35 p.m. in New York. Despite a pro-crypto White House and surging institutional adoption, Bitcoin has plummeted about 40% since rocketing to a record in early October. Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, GC=F, SI=F, ^GSPC.
